items.title: WTW’s Zurich Deal Puts Its Insurance Technology Business In Focus
items.summary: Willis Towers Watson Plc (NASDAQ:WTW), a global risk and advisory firm, expanded its relationship with Zurich Insurance Company Limited (OTC:ZURVY) through a global agreement to deploy its Radar pricing and analytics platform across Zurich’s target Retail markets worldwide. WTW shares rose in Monday’s premarket session following the announcement. Financial terms of the expanded agreement were not disclosed.
